subject: Re: MuZero hardening — staffing + compute
body:
Ulla,

Plan:

Staffing — Rafael owns agent correctness and the planning-knob documentation; Paloma owns the SEED RL infra path (learner/actor split, preemption recovery); Rosa takes the CI convergence gate and reference configs. That's a lean three, but the scope is hardening, not research.

Compute — single-machine work runs on titan-a100 best-effort. The April distributed atari validation needs about 64 A100s for two weeks; I've sized that within our standing agents-rl share, no special reservation needed. We deliberately stay off vulcan for this one.

Sequencing note: SEED's actor fan-out is where I expect the bodies to be buried — the pseudocode-faithful agent plus a few hundred actors has queue-depth interactions the release never had to care about. Paloma starts there next week.

CI gate on track for 03-06.

Ivo
